## Overview

This report presents CJS (Cormack-Jolly-Seber) survival estimates comparing three taggers (A, B, C) across release locations and reaches. The report includes capture history summary tables showing the distribution of fish by detection pattern. Analysis includes Chinook salmon only. Steelhead analyses are not included in this round due to insufficient data.

## Survival Estimates

### Rock Island Tailrace (_R_1) - Chinook

|Reach|Tagger A: Estimate|Tagger A: SE|Tagger B: Estimate|Tagger B: SE|Tagger C: Estimate|Tagger C: SE|P-value (F-test)|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|Release to CB|0.9848|0.0067|0.9881|0.0059|0.991|0.0052|0.764|
|CB to Sunland|0.9815|0.0075|0.9819|0.0073|0.9939|0.0043|0.355|
|Sunland to Wanapum|0.9342|0.0139|0.9446|0.0127|0.9361|0.0136|0.842|
|Wanapum to Mattawa|0.906|0.0169|0.899|0.0172|0.9013|0.0171|0.206|
|Mattawa to Priest Rapids|0.9777|0.009|0.9714|0.0101|0.9491|0.0133|0.161|
|Priest Rapids to Lower Ringold|0.9163|0.0171|0.9101|0.0175|0.9004|0.0185|0.947|

|Reach|Tagger A: Estimate|Tagger A: SE|Tagger B: Estimate|Tagger B: SE|Tagger C: Estimate|Tagger C: SE|P-value (F-test)|

## Capture History Summary

Capture history patterns show the sequence of detections for each fish at acoustic receiver arrays. A value of "1" indicates the fish was detected at that site, while "0" indicates no detection. These patterns are used in the CJS model to estimate survival probabilities.

## Notes

- **Species**: Chinook (CHN)
- **Statistical Test**: F-test for homogeneity of tagger effects
- **Confidence Level**: Standard errors provided for each estimate
- **Significant Results**: P-values < 0.05 indicate significant tagger effects
- **Capture History Interpretation**: Detection patterns are used by CJS models to estimate survival. Higher numbers of 1s indicate more detections (likely higher survival through those reaches).
